key_idea: A digit is subtracted iff some strictly larger digit appears anywhere to its right, so scan right-to-left keeping the running maximum.
sketch: Scan each numeral from the right, tracking the largest digit value seen so far; add the digit if it is >= that maximum (and update the maximum), otherwise subtract it. O(total length). Pitfalls: results can be negative and reach about 3e8, read lines of up to 3e5 characters, equal digits are added not subtracted.
